__broaden__.δύ: δύο — two; numeral, elided (δύ’ = δύο): ’two (handmaids)’ · also elided δύο with a dual participle: ’two (going together)’ (δύ’ ἐρχομένω)
__broaden__.δεξιὸν: δεξιός — on the right, right; masc. acc. sg., with ὦμον · also masc. acc. sg., of position, agreeing with a bird sent as an omen: ’on the right’ (δεξιὸν ἐρῳδιόν ’a heron on the right’)
__broaden__.νοήσῃ: νοέω — perceive, notice; aor. subj. 3 sg., after μή (fear): ’lest she notice’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after εἰ: ’if he notices’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ)
__broaden__.πέρ: περ — at least, even; enclitic restrictive/intensive particle, accented before the enclitic μοι: τιμήν πέρ ’honour at least’ · also intensive after a relative adj., accented before the enclitic τε: οἷός πέρ τε ’just such as’ · also intensive after a relative pronoun, accented before the enclitic φασι: ’whom indeed’ · also intensive after ὅτε, accented before τε: ’just when’ · also intensive after εἰ, accented before the enclitic τε: ’if indeed’ (εἴ πέρ τε νοήσῃ ’if a man indeed notices’)
__broaden__.πέρι: περί — about, over, for; prep. + gen. with anastrophe (accent thrown back, after its noun): ’over, about’ · also adv. of degree, with a genitive of the person: ’beyond others, exceedingly’ (οὗ πέρι … κραδίη ’whose heart beyond others’)
__broaden__.περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’)
__broaden__.πλέων: πλέω — sail; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sailing’ · also πλέων = πλείων (comparative of πολύς): ’more, further’; masc./fem. nom. sg. (πλέων … τῶν δύο μοιράων ’more than the two parts’)
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’)

__broaden__.ἕλοι: αἱρέω — take, seize, capture; aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’would take’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause of hoped-for result: ’might catch’ (εἴ τινά … ἕλοι ’to see if he might catch someone’)
